posts.content_md:
A few of us here on the East Coast are going to get together and hang out for a day. Holography will surely be the overpowering theme and it will be totally informal. We are shooting for Saturday May 26th about noon in Baltimore Maryland. If anyone else is interested in attending shoot me an e-mail.

Jon K, I know Georgia is quite a drive from Baltimore, but it would be nice if you could make it. I can give you a sofa if you need to spend the night.

That goes for anyone else that wants to attend but the drive in one day may be too much. 

John
